author: KEXP
description: The OSEES' return to Live on KEXP comes in the form of yet another high energy live performance blending psychedelia, punk, and garage rock. In a special Gathering Space show, the band performs "Block Of Ice" and more.
title: OSEES perform "Block Of Ice" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
